$comment: Part II Section B — XML mapping for power(s) of attorney, into UBL cac:PowerOfAttorney under cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:Party of the RESPONSE document. One repeated cac:PowerOfAttorney per array item (aggregate-record forEach): Description + the AgentParty (name / identifier / country). Field `to` paths are relative to each PowerOfAttorney record. CAVEAT: no Schematron/sample reference exists for this block (see sectionB.schema.json).

rules.$comment: One cac:PowerOfAttorney per array item; fields are relative to the item.

fields.$comment: Agent identifier value + mandatory @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02). The agent identifier carries no scheme field to derive the agency from, so @schemeAgencyID resolves to the DEFAULT of the 'identifier-scheme-agency' profile (model-sources/registries/scheme-agency-profile.json → 'OP'). Not user-entered.
